summary: Find the truth behind the legend in an eerie Hidden Object puzzle-adventure
description:
The eerie Hidden Object Adventure is based on an ancient legend. Explore a haunted castle full of deadly puzzles created for true fans of mystery games.

Play the puzzle-adventure game to:
- Experience an indie video game
- Enjoy an original story and a hand-drawn artwork
- Earn coins in replayable Hidden Object scenes
- Solve smart puzzles and brainteasers

Your little sister has always loved mysteries and adventures, and that's why she became an archaeologist. But ever since she was summoned to excavations in the Carpathians, Rose suffered terrible nightmares. Anxious, you come to see her just to find out that she vanished. Now it's up to you to learn the truth behind the medieval legend before the haunted castle claims another victim.

Inspired by dark stories about Countess Dracula, the Hidden Object Adventure gets history and magic interwoven. Roam around a remote village, where heathen beliefs and rituals are still a commonplace. Challenge your Hidden Object skills to uncover ancient manuscripts and decipher forgotten riddles. Collect gold coins, crack mind-twisting puzzles and brainteasers. Stop the blood ritual and save your sister in the thrilling adventure game.

Questions about Bathory: Bloody Countess Lite? Contact our tech support at support@absolutist.com.

If you enjoyed the puzzle-adventure game, discover more of our mystery games!
